title: You don’t survive this long by luck.
paragraphs: You don’t survive this long by luck.
Israel should have been erased.
Empires rose against her. Kings plotted against her. Armies surrounded her. Hatred followed her through centuries like a shadow that refused to die.
But here’s what most people don’t realize…
There is protection you cannot see.
“The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is your shade on your right hand.” Psalm 121:5
God saw it.

He saw Pharaoh.
He saw Haman.
He saw Rome.
He saw every nation that said, “Let us wipe them out.”
And still Israel remained.
Not because Israel was perfect.
Scripture is clear: sin brings judgment. Rebellion brings discipline. God does not overlook wickedness, not in Israel, not in the Church, not in you.
“You only have I known of all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.” Amos 3:2
Read that again.

Chosen does not mean untouched.
Chosen means accountable.
And that should shake you, because you thought God’s patience meant permission.
You knew.
You knew when you kept returning to the same sin. You knew when you prayed with your lips but wandered with your heart. You knew when conviction came and you silenced it.
Originally written by Gospel Warrior.
Yet even in judgment, God’s covenant mercy speaks louder than the grave.
“He who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.” Psalm 121:4
The same God who preserved Israel is the God who sent Jesus Christ to save sinners.

Not by bloodline.
Not by religion.
Not by good behavior.
“For by grace you have been saved through faith… not a result of works.” Ephesians 2:8-9
Jesus is the true protection your soul needs.
Because the greatest enemy is not a nation outside your borders.
It is sin inside your heart.
And Christ did not come to decorate your life. He came to rescue it.
On the cross, judgment fell. Grace opened. Blood spoke. The Savior rose.
So repent.
Turn from sin. Trust Jesus. Stop hiding behind spiritual language while your heart stays cold.
